scene-01: Welcome to Global Chemicals and Maintenance Systems LLC, Al Barami Group of Companies. Today, we'll introduce you to the key safety guidelines and best practices to ensure your safety while working with us. Safety is everyone's responsibility.
scene-02: GCMS, over the last four decades, has been actively associated with Power and Water and Wastewater industries — life's most essentials in the Sultanate of Oman. Established in 1963, and becoming a 100% Omani company in the year 1976, it became a member of Al Barami Group of Companies. GCMS handles the entire spectrum of the project lifecycle, which includes BOOT — Build, Own, Operate and Transfer — Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Testing, Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance, and Facilities Management, across Power, Water and Wastewater and Renewable Energy. GCMS currently has a workforce of more than one thousand five hundred people, spread across all regions of the Sultanate of Oman. GCMS is committed to being a leader in Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Protection, conducting its business with the utmost emphasis on the safety of its people, its processes, and the well-being of the communities and stakeholders.
scene-03: GCMS is approved as a Grade A Electrical and Solar Contractor by the Distribution Code Review Panel. We are registered on the Joint Supplier Registration System for Oil and Gas, and GCMS is a member of OPAL. GCMS is certified with the ISO QHSE Management Systems 9001, 14001 and 45001, and is registered as Excellent Grade with the Tender Board.
scene-04: Before we go any further, let me introduce you to the fact that you're our top priority, and safety is our first priority in our daily working hours — whether you're a visitor, contractor, industry vendor, or on your first job. It is important that everyone has the knowledge to make the right decisions to stay safe.
scene-05: Here are a few simple rules to get your visit starting off right. Please ensure that your visitor pass is visible at all times, and return it when you leave. Your safety is your responsibility, and our host will assist you — please feel free to ask them any questions. To protect company property, assets and privacy, photographs and video can only be taken with prior approval.
scene-06: Before you start, it's essential to wear the correct Personal Protective Equipment, or PPE. Your safety gear will help protect you from potential hazards. Always check your PPE before starting work.
scene-07: Know the emergency exits and the locations of safety equipment, such as fire extinguishers, first-aid kits, and emergency assembly points. In case of emergency, follow the evacuation plan.
scene-08: Identifying hazards is the first step in preventing accidents. Always be alert about potential risks in your work area. Report any hazards immediately to your supervisor.
scene-09: Follow safe work practices at all times. Always read signs and instructions carefully. When lifting, use your legs, not your back.
scene-10: GCMS's twelve Golden Life Saving Rules are a set of concise commitment statements, carefully designed to ensure that workers work safely and return safely to their loved ones. Rule one — Life of Line: protect yourself by complying with HSE rules. Rule two — Public Safety: safeguard the public from significant hazards. Rule three — Traffic Safety: always adhere to road safety rules. Rule four — Electrical Safety: follow the Electrical Safety Rules without fail. Rule five — Lifting Safety: no lifting activities are allowed without a Permit to Work. Rule six — Excavation Safety: no excavation activities are allowed without a Permit to Work. Rule seven — Hot Work Safety: ensure fire protection measures are in place before starting hot work. Rule eight — Work at Height: always wear a full-body safety harness when working above one and a half meters. Rule nine — Confined Space Safety: no confined space activities are allowed without a Permit to Work. Rule ten — Radiography Work Safety: no radiography activities are permitted without a Permit to Work. Rule eleven — No drugs, alcohol, or smoking: drugs and alcohol are strictly prohibited while on task and on company premises. Rule twelve — Personal Protective Equipment: it is essential to wear the correct PPE before starting work. The twelve Golden Life Saving Rules pocketbook is distributed to every employee in their preferred language — English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu and Bangla.
scene-11: Report any incidents or near-misses. Reporting helps prevent future accidents. Near misses are incidents that could have resulted in injury — report them!
scene-12: Safety is a team effort. Let's work together to ensure everyone stays safe on the job. Safety first — always!
scene-13: Thank you for completing your HSE induction. For any questions or concerns about safety, please speak with your supervisor. Stay safe!
